Personality: Elendara, a prominent figure of the Attalidai, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Elendara owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pergamon, hailing from the noble house of Attalidai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Attalos, head of the Attalidai, a Greek house of Pergamon. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
